templates.preset_description: Start from the closest scenario, then fine-tune only what differs. Presets fill image source, catalog scope, OS, and a cloud-init example together.
templates.curated_group_description: Grouped templates refined from real production practice. Use them as your internal baseline or a tailored starting point.
templates.official_group_description: Starter templates aligned with the KubeVirt/CDI image-import path, preferred as the general persistent-root baseline. Use CDI PVC Clone only when you already manage golden image PVCs.
templates.recommended_group_description: General starting points aligned with the KubeVirt community's most common recommended paths.
templates.customized_group_description: Curated from the developer's real production instances and provided for reference only. They are not recommended for direct use. templates.catalog_scope_help: Controls who can see this template in the request catalog.
templates.request_flow_reason_admin_only: ContainerDisk templates are admin-only by default and are not exposed for general self-service selection.
templates.request_flow_reason_hidden: Change catalog scope from unclassified to test, prod, or all to expose it.
templates.request_flow_reason_disabled: Enable this template before it can appear in the request wizard.
templates.request_flow_reason_unsupporte: This source type is not enabled for the standard VM request wizard.
templates.containerdisk_scope_warning: ContainerDisk is an ephemeral root disk. Keep it limited to test or unclassified catalog scope.

instanceSizes.title: Instance Sizes
instanceSizes.subtitle: Hardware resource configurations (CPU, memory, capabilities)
instanceSizes.preset_description: Bundle the linked kubevirt parameters into four scenario presets. Pick the closest baseline first, then use advanced settings only for the delta.
instanceSizes.recommended_group_descript: General Linux and Windows baselines derived from common KubeVirt community sizing patterns, keeping only the broadest and most compatible settings.
instanceSizes.customized_group_descripti: Curated from the developer's real production instances and provided for reference only. They are not recommended for direct use. Because they depend on specific environment choices and practices, they may not fit every cluster or use case. Prefer the community-recommended set unless you have clear local constraints.
instanceSizes.cpu_help: The vCPU size for this instance. Combined with CPU Threads, CPU Sockets, and scheduling policy to determine the effective topology.
instanceSizes.memory_help: Guest-visible memory size. If Hugepages or Dedicated CPU is enabled, also verify node capacity and page size alignment.
instanceSizes.disk_help: Default disk size in whole GB. The actual boot source and media type are still defined by the Template.
instanceSizes.root_volume_mode_help: Controls how the root DataVolume storage mode is authored. Auto keeps the size cluster-agnostic; Explicit pins a specific accessModes + volumeMode combination.
instanceSizes.root_volume_mode_auto_help: The size keeps a cluster-agnostic intent only. Approval resolves the actual storage class and root volume mode against the target cluster StorageProfile, and blocks approval if the result is ambiguous.
instanceSizes.root_volume_mode_explicit_: Approval validates the selected combination against the target cluster StorageProfile. If the selected storage class does not support it, the request cannot be approved.
instanceSizes.dv_volume_mode_help: CDI DataVolume PVC volumeMode for the root disk. Use Block only when the target StorageClass explicitly supports it.
instanceSizes.dv_access_modes_help: CDI DataVolume PVC accessModes for the root disk. Approval checks the target StorageProfile and rejects unsupported combinations.
instanceSizes.dv_access_modes_required: Select at least one access mode
instanceSizes.cpu_request_help: Used only when CPU Overcommit is enabled. This is the scheduler request; the CPU ceiling still comes from the CPU size above.
instanceSizes.cpu_request_exceeds_limit: CPU request cannot exceed CPU limit.
instanceSizes.memory_request_help: Used only when Memory Overcommit is enabled. This is the scheduler request; the guest-visible memory still comes from the Memory size above.
instanceSizes.memory_request_exceeds_lim: Memory request cannot exceed memory limit.
instanceSizes.sort_order_help: Lower values appear first in the catalog. This affects display order only, not scheduling or resource allocation.
instanceSizes.catalog_scope_help: Controls which request environments can see this size. Unclassified stays hidden from the VM request wizard.
instanceSizes.dedicated_help: Pin vCPUs to physical cores for more deterministic performance. Conflicts with CPU Overcommit and will disable it automatically. Typically paired with Hugepages.
instanceSizes.sriov_help: Indicates that this size requires SR-IOV networking capability. The actual network attachment and interface definition still comes from the Template or later network configuration.
instanceSizes.hugepages_help: When Hugepages is set, Shepherd sends memory request equal to memory limit and Memory Overcommit is unavailable.
instanceSizes.hugepages_disabled_by_memo: Disable Memory Overcommit before choosing Hugepages Size.
instanceSizes.spec_overrides_help: Optional raw KubeVirt spec overrides stored as JSON.
instanceSizes.spec_overrides_invalid: Instance size spec overrides JSON is invalid
instanceSizes.enabled_help: When disabled, the size remains in the platform but is no longer offered as a selectable catalog entry.
instanceSizes.kubevirt_hotplug_defaults_: KubeVirt can derive cpu.maxSockets and memory.maxGuest from liveUpdateConfiguration when a VM does not provide its own values. Shepherd keeps them out of guided fields; use raw JSON only for deliberate overrides.
instanceSizes.resolved_preview_help: This preview live-merges the indexed fields above with the spec overrides below. Changes to CPU, memory, overcommit, SR-IOV, or advanced spec fields are reflected here immediately. _platform contains platform-managed indexed fields and is not part of raw KubeVirt spec.
instanceSizes.enable_cpu_overcommit_help: Allows CPU request to be lower than the configured ceiling to improve utilization. Under sustained load it can increase contention, jitter, and stability risk, so production usually should keep it disabled. Conflicts with Dedicated CPU.
instanceSizes.enable_memory_overcommit_h: Allows Memory request to be lower than the configured ceiling to improve utilization. Under memory pressure it can increase reclaim, jitter, or OOM risk, so production usually should keep it disabled.
instanceSizes.memory_overcommit_disabled: Memory Overcommit is unavailable when Hugepages {{size}} is enabled because memory request must equal the memory limit.
instanceSizes.overcommit_ratio_hint: Can improve utilization, but under sustained load it increases stability risk. Production usually should keep it disabled.
instanceSizes.mask.cpu_model_help: CPU emulation model. Use 'host-passthrough' for maximum performance, 'host-model' for migration-safe near-native performance.
instanceSizes.mask.machine_type_help: QEMU machine type. q35 provides modern PCIe topology and is recommended for all workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.eviction_strategy_hel: Strategy when node is drained. 'LiveMigrate' migrates VM to another node; 'None' shuts down the VM.
instanceSizes.mask.io_threads_policy_hel: Controls KubeVirt disk IOThreads. Use 'auto' to allocate a bounded pool and distribute disks across IOThreads; leaving it empty disables IOThreads unless a disk requests a dedicated IOThread.
instanceSizes.mask.dedicated_cpu_placeme: Pin vCPUs to physical cores for guaranteed CPU performance. Required for DPDK and latency-sensitive workloads. Requires hugepages.
instanceSizes.mask.isolate_emulator_thre: Isolate QEMU emulator thread on a dedicated CPU core. Useful for ultra-low-latency workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.gpu_devices_help: Configure one or more GPU device entries. Each item should include a unique name and a valid deviceName from your cluster plugin.
instanceSizes.mask.network_multiqueue_he: Enable multi-queue for virtio network interfaces. Improves network throughput on multi-core VMs.
instanceSizes.mask.block_multiqueue_help: Enable multi-queue for block devices (disks). Improves disk I/O throughput on multi-core VMs.
instanceSizes.mask.autoattach_serial_hel: Keep the serial console attached for low-level server diagnostics and break-glass access even when graphics are unavailable.
instanceSizes.mask.autoattach_graphics_h: Keep the minimal graphics device attached so VNC remains available. Disable only for explicitly headless, density-optimized server profiles.
instanceSizes.mask.autoattach_memballoon: Enable memory ballooning device. Disable for latency-sensitive workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.autoattach_vsock_help: VSOCK provides host-guest communication without network stack. Enable for guest-agent connectivity on Linux VMs.
instanceSizes.mask.rng_help: Attach virtual hardware random number generator device. Recommended for encryption workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.termination_grace_hel: Seconds to wait before forcefully terminating the VM on shutdown. Linux: 0 (immediate), Windows: 180 (graceful shutdown).
instanceSizes.mask.node_selector_help: Restrict scheduling to nodes with matching labels. Example: kubevirt.io/ksm-enabled = true.
instanceSizes.mask.pod_antiaffinity_help: Configure pod anti-affinity rules for the VM template. Use this to keep VMs from the same service on different nodes when needed, for example by matching shepherd.io/service-id on kubernetes.io/hostname.
instanceSizes.mask.template_annotations_: Key/value annotations on the VM template metadata. Example: ovn.kubernetes.io/allow_live_migration = true.
instanceSizes.mask.acpi_help: Enable ACPI for power management. Required for Windows VMs.
instanceSizes.mask.apic_help: Enable APIC for interrupt handling. Required for Windows VMs.
instanceSizes.mask.hyperv_spinlocks_help: Enable spinlocks for Windows kernel synchronization. Spinlocks count defaults to 8191.
instanceSizes.mask.hyperv_vendorid_help: Expose KubeVirt as the hypervisor vendor to the guest OS. Required for some Windows licensing scenarios.
instanceSizes.mask.numa_guest_mapping_he: Expose guest-to-host NUMA passthrough mapping. Use for dedicated CPU and hugepages tuned workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.clock_utc_help: Expose UTC clock to the guest. Common for Windows workloads.
instanceSizes.mask.clock_hyperv_timer_he: Enable Hyper-V paravirtualized timer support for Windows guests.
instanceSizes.mask.guest_agent_ping_help: Use QEMU guest agent ping as the liveness probe mechanism.
